cards.example: 春秋战国是社会动荡的时期。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Spring and Autumn and Warring States were a time of social upheaval.
cards.breakdown: 动：用力（力）让重物动起来 · 荡：水（氵）面上草木（艹）随波摇晃，动荡不安

cards.example: 那是一个大变革的时代。
cards.exampleTranslation: It was an era of great transformation.
cards.breakdown: 变：用行动（攵）打乱原样，让它改变 · 革：一张兽皮（革）被彻底加工改造

cards.example: 东周分为春秋和战国两个时期。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Eastern Zhou is divided into the Spring-Autumn and Warring-States periods.
cards.breakdown: 时：太阳（日）走到寺庙（寺）上方，表示时间 · 期：月亮（月）转一圈（其），一个周期

cards.example: 春秋时期奴隶制度逐渐瓦解。
cards.exampleTranslation: During the Spring and Autumn period the slave system gradually collapsed.
cards.breakdown: 瓦：屋顶的瓦片，一片片碎裂掉落 · 解：用刀（刀）把牛角（角）从牛（牛）身上分开

cards.example: 春秋初期周天子力量很弱。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the early Spring and Autumn period the Zhou king's power was weak.
cards.breakdown: 力：一条用力的肌肉 · 量：用工具一点点称量、衡量

cards.example: 诸侯不再听从天子的命令。
cards.exampleTranslation: The lords no longer obeyed the king's orders.
cards.breakdown: 听：用耳朵听，再点头接受 · 从：一个人跟在另一个人后面（从），跟随服从

cards.example: 诸侯不听天子的命令。
cards.exampleTranslation: The lords didn't heed the king's commands.
cards.breakdown: 命：口（口）中发出、让人听令（令）的话 · 令：人在高台上发号施令

cards.back: to fight over / scramble for / contend for
cards.example: 诸侯为了争夺土地和人口而打仗。
cards.exampleTranslation: The lords fought to seize land and people.
cards.breakdown: 争：两只手抢同一样东西 · 夺：用手（寸）把怀里（大）的东西硬抢走

cards.back: to contend for hegemony / vie for supremacy
cards.example: 春秋时诸侯争霸。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the Spring and Autumn period the lords contended for hegemony.
cards.breakdown: 争：两只手相争 · 霸：下着雨（雨）也要称王（革+月），做天下的霸主

cards.example: 打赢的大国成为霸主。
cards.exampleTranslation: The victorious great state became the hegemon.
cards.breakdown: 霸：压倒众人、称雄一方 · 主：油灯上的一点火苗（丶），一家之主

cards.example: 齐桓公最早称霸。
cards.exampleTranslation: Duke Huan of Qi was the first to become hegemon.
cards.breakdown: 称：用手掂量后郑重宣称 · 霸：压倒众人，称雄一方

cards.example: 诸侯国之间常常发生战争。
cards.exampleTranslation: Wars often broke out between the states.
cards.breakdown: 战：拿着武器（戈）与对手（单）交战 · 争：两手相争

cards.example: 大家要承认霸主的地位。
cards.exampleTranslation: Everyone had to recognize the hegemon's status.
cards.breakdown: 承：双手向上托住，接受下来 · 认：用话（讠）点头认下（人）

cards.example: 霸主有很高的地位。
cards.exampleTranslation: The hegemon held a very high status.
cards.breakdown: 地：一块（也）土地（土） · 位：一个人（亻）站在自己的位置（立）上

cards.example: 战国七雄都进行了改革。
cards.exampleTranslation: All seven Warring States carried out reforms.
cards.breakdown: 改：用行动（攵）把自己（己）变好 · 革：把兽皮彻底加工，除旧更新

cards.example: 各国进行变法。
cards.exampleTranslation: The states carried out reforms.
cards.breakdown: 进：向前走（辶），越走越好 · 行：左右脚交替迈出，做起来

cards.back: to appoint (to a post) / put to use
cards.example: 秦孝公任用商鞅变法。
cards.exampleTranslation: Duke Xiao of Qin appointed Shang Yang to carry out reforms.
cards.breakdown: 任：一个人（亻）挑起担子（壬），担当职责 · 用：把东西拿来使用

cards.back: to reform the law / carry out political reform
cards.example: 商鞅变法使秦国强大。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shang Yang's reforms made Qin powerful.
cards.breakdown: 变：打乱原样，让它改变 · 法：像水（氵）一样有规矩的法律

cards.example: 老百姓都不相信。
cards.exampleTranslation: The common people didn't believe it.
cards.breakdown: 相：用眼睛（目）看着树木（木），仔细端详 · 信：一个人（亻）说的话（言）算数，值得信任

cards.example: 商鞅把赏金增加到五十金。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shang Yang increased the reward to fifty gold.
cards.breakdown: 增：往土（土）上一层层堆叠（曾），越堆越多 · 加：出力（力）再添上一张口（口）

cards.example: 果然有人把木头搬到北门。
cards.exampleTranslation: Sure enough, someone moved the log to the north gate.
cards.breakdown: 果：树（木）上真的结出了果实（田） · 然：如此、这样

cards.back: to keep one's word / count (be valid)
cards.example: 政府说话算数。
cards.exampleTranslation: The government kept its word.
cards.breakdown: 算：用竹（竹）制算具，两手（廾）拨算，算得清清楚楚 · 数：一个个点数

cards.example: 这件事很快传遍了全国。
cards.exampleTranslation: The news quickly spread across the whole country.
cards.breakdown: 传：一个人（亻）把话一个个（专）传下去 · 遍：走（辶）遍每一处

cards.example: 新法规定土地可以自由买卖。
cards.exampleTranslation: The new law stipulated that land could be freely bought and sold.
cards.breakdown: 规：用圆规画圆，定出规矩 · 定：在屋子（宀）里稳稳定下，不再变

cards.example: 商鞅废除了旧的制度。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shang Yang abolished the old system.
cards.breakdown: 废：大屋子（广）里把没用的东西丢弃 · 除：把多余（余）的土堆（阝）铲掉，清除干净

cards.example: 变法剥夺了贵族的特权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The reform took away the nobles' privileges.
cards.breakdown: 贵：手里捧着财宝（贝），身份高贵 · 族：旗帜（方）下聚集的一群人

cards.back: to establish (firmly) / set up for good
cards.example: 封建制度逐步确立起来。
cards.exampleTranslation: The feudal system was gradually and firmly established.
cards.breakdown: 确：像石头（石）一样确实、坚定 · 立：稳稳站定

cards.example: 秦国成为当时最富强的国家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Qin became the most prosperous and powerful state of the time.
cards.breakdown: 富：屋顶（宀）下有田有粮，家里富足 · 强：像强弓（弓）一样有力量

cards.example: 变法使秦国军力加强。
cards.exampleTranslation: The reform strengthened Qin's military power.
cards.breakdown: 军：军队 · 力：力量

cards.example: 封建制度在各国逐步确立。
cards.exampleTranslation: The feudal system was gradually established in the various states.
cards.breakdown: 逐：一步步（辶）追着猪（豕）走 · 步：左脚右脚（止）一步步向前

cards.example: 生产粮食多的人可以免除劳役。
cards.exampleTranslation: Those who produced much grain could be exempted from labor service.
cards.breakdown: 粮：把米（米）量好（量）储存的口粮 · 食：一个人（人）低头吃饭（良）

cards.example: 生产布帛多的人受到奖励。
cards.exampleTranslation: Those who produced much cloth and silk were rewarded.
cards.breakdown: 布：用手把织好的布料摊开 · 帛：白色（白）的丝织品（巾）

cards.example: 生产多的人可免除劳役。
cards.exampleTranslation: Those who produced a lot could be exempt from corvée.
cards.breakdown: 劳：在灯火下用力（力）干活，很辛劳 · 役：拿着工具（殳）被派去（彳）服劳役
